plant_standard.txt fixture -- see PROVENANCE.md.

MATERIAL_REACTION_PRODUCT below uses this stream's own simplified 3-arg
fixture form (token:item_type:node_suffix), not DF's real nested material
structure -- the audit verified token names and which crops carry them
(sec2, citing plant_standard.txt lines 13-14, 69-71, 117-118, 164-165,
282-283 for DRINK_MAT/SEED_MAT on plump helmet, pig tail, cave wheat, sweet
pod, dimple cup), not the internal argument syntax, which was not quoted.
GROWDUR and season-flag values are QUOTED for plump helmet, pig tail, cave
wheat and sweet pod (audit sec7, citing plant_standard.txt lines 28/53,
74/91, 121/147, 168/206). Dimple cup's own season flags were not quoted by
the audit; marked RECONSTRUCTED below.

[OBJECT:PLANT]

[PLANT:PLUMP_HELMET]
	[NAME:plump helmet]
	[GROWDUR:300]
	[SPRING][SUMMER][AUTUMN][WINTER]
	[VALUE:2]
	[MATERIAL_VALUE:2]
	[MATERIAL_REACTION_PRODUCT:DRINK_MAT:DRINK:PLUMP_HELMET_WINE]
	[MATERIAL_REACTION_PRODUCT:SEED_MAT:SEEDS:PLUMP_HELMET_SEED]
